newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbeks in gold mining venture with Canadian firm.
newsitem.headline: Uzbeks in gold mining venture with Canadian firm.

text.p: Uzbekistan has set up a joint venture with a unit of Williams Resources Inc of Canada to prospect and mine for gold in the Central Asian state, a government official said on Tuesday.

Alexander Ogarkov of the State Geology and Mineral Resources Committee said the UZ-CAN joint venture, with Williams unit RUX Resources Inc, would work in the Kairagach and Tashek regions, as well as in the silver-bearing Aktepe area.
Kairagach has already been explored and has 15 tonnes of gold, he said, adding that Altepe required more exploration.
The gold-bearing areas would require an initial investment of $50 million.
RUZ would complete a feasibility study by 1998.
Equity in the venture is split equally, with the Uzbek stake held by the committee and the state geological enterprise.
